metadata.question: Did the global ocean surface color show a shift toward a greener hue between 2002 and 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to analyze ocean color changes globally between 2002 and 2022 - MODIS Aqua ocean color products would be ideal (MOD/MYD09GA or ocean color specific products) - Use MODIS Ocean Color products like "JAXA/GCOM-C/L3/OCEAN/CHLA/V3" or NASA ocean color - Actually, for ocean color/chlorophyll, better to use: "NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI" which has chlorophyll_a - Date ranges: 2002 (early period) vs 2022 (recent period) - Location: Global oceans (exclude land masses) 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask out land and focus only on ocean surfaces - May need to mask poor quality pixels - Cloud masking less critical for ocean color composites which are already processed 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Ocean color shift toward green would mean increased chlorophyll-a concentration - Compare mean chlorophyll-a or ocean color indices between the two periods - Valid zero would be actual low chlorophyll values - Need to check if collections have data for both periods - Check pixel counts to ensure valid data exists ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define global ocean region (exclude land) const ocean = ee.Geometry.Polygon( [[[-180, -60], [180, -60], [180, 60], [-180, 60], [-180, -60]]], null, false ); // Time periods for comparison const period1Start = '2002-01-01'; const period1End = '2003-12-31'; const period2Start = '2021-01-01'; const period2End = '2022-12-31'; // Load MODIS Aqua Ocean Color data (chlorophyll-a as proxy for green hue) const col1 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .filterDate(period1Start, period1End) .filterBounds(ocean) .select('chlor_a'); const col2 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .filterDate(period2Start, period2End) .filterBounds(ocean) .select('chlor_a'); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2002-2003 Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`2021-2022 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("Empty collection for one or both periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Create median composites for each period const img1 = col1.median(); const img2 = col2.median(); // Calculate statistics for both periods const stats1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: ocean, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).getInfo(); const stats2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: ocean, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).getInfo(); const mean1 = stats1.chlor_a_mean; const count1 = stats1.chlor_a_count; const mean2 = stats2.chlor_a_mean; const count2 = stats2.chlor_a_count; console.log(`2002-2003 Mean Chlorophyll: ${mean1} mg/m³, Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`2021-2022 Mean Chlorophyll: ${mean2} mg/m³, Pixels: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (mean1 === null || mean1 === undefined || mean2 === null || mean2 === undefined || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Calculate percentage change const percentChange = ((mean2 - mean1) / mean1) * 100; console.log(`Chlorophyll change: ${percentChange.toFixed(2)}%`); // Green shift = increased chlorophyll-a (threshold: >2% increase) if (mean2 > mean1 && percentChange > 2) { console.log("Ocean surface shows greener hue in 2021-2022."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("No significant green shift detected."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
